(a) CBOW learns the representation of 𝑝2 from its neighboring POIs 𝑝1 and 𝑝3. (b) POIs are connected to visit-time and category entities through typed associations, while directed POI transitions are retained for relation-aware mobility modeling.

Figure 6: Sensitivity analysis of the KG loss weight 𝜆KG.

Figure 7 shows the influence of the number of negative samples, which is varied from 1 to 10. Increasing the number of negative samples does not lead to a consistent improvement. Instead, the metrics fluctuate within a relatively small range after a moderate number of negative samples is used. More negative samples provide additional constraints for knowledge graph learning but also increase the training cost. Based on the overall results, 4 negative samples are used in our experiments as a practical balance between model performance and computational efficiency.
